name: gotham-city-website-platform
description: Gotham City full-stack FiveM server website platform.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
